items.quote: At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt
items.claim: The LORD brought the children of Israel out of Egypt, knowledge to be confirmed at evening

items.quote: in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD
items.claim: The children of Israel will see the glory of the LORD in the morning

items.quote: when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full
items.claim: The LORD will give flesh in the evening and bread in the morning
